promptId.description: Correlation id echoed in env.acp_prompt_complete. The sidecar acknowledges the dispatch immediately; the terminal outcome arrives as a notification with this id, letting the control plane ignore a completion from a superseded turn.

relaunch.description: When true, the sidecar terminates any existing agent process and launches a fresh ACP session before sending the prompt. Used to recover a failed execution with a clean session in the same workspace.
